speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Master Shakespeare. In since noon, and mud to the fetlock. I have thy mistress's letter. The horses drink before I make a long talk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let them drink, Master Hobbins. I have one letter, and two groats sewn in a paper, and I will not shout the rest across the yard.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twelve hours to Wycombe if the way's dry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And it is not dry.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: It is not. Oats are up a penny at Oxford. A bridge plank is gone at Shipston, so we go down to the ford and up, and the beasts do not like the joke.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the twins' day will be late in the house as well as late on the paper.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I left the High Cross on Monday week. Their day will be nine days old when I put this in her hand. They'll take it kindly, late.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They'll take the groats kindly. The letter may do as it can.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twopence, before I mount, and not as a thing shouted after me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twopence. Here.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Sewn, is it. I will not unpick another man's thread to see the silver. If the paper says the groats are in, they are in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are in. One each. I was going to tell you which is which, and there is no which. They are the same.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Then do not tell me. Tell the paper. Thy mouth will have changed it by Wycombe.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will write it on the outside.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Is there anything the mistress is expected to guess?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. One plain line. The two groats are within. One to each twin.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: That, she will not have to guess. A pan mended. A ladle found where thy father swore he never put it. And a quarrel over whose turn it was at the well, which I did not stay to judge.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The pan, the ladle, the well. I have them.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: And thy father. Thou wilt ask.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I ask. The cough.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Mending.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mending. I will not write it into a better word.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Do not. She said mending, and mending is what I carry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not send the day I come. I do not know it, and I will not have her look for a day I have not got.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Then do not know it on my horse. The bundle is light. God keep them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you, Master Hobbins.
